# Set-up

This markdown makes the plots for Figure 3: Doublet detection performance is reduced after ambient RNA correction in engineered datasets

In this markdown, we will evaluate the performance of doublet calling using `scDblFinder` on all engineered dataset, both uncorrected as well as ambient corrected (`decontX BG`, `decontX`, `soupX`, `CellBender`). 


## Load libraries

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(readr)
  library(here)
  library(Seurat)
  library(scater)
  library(qs2)
  library(DropletUtils)
  library(patchwork)
  library(rstatix)
  library(yardstick)
  library(caret)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(png)
})
```


## Load data

These performance metrics were computed in [this file]().

```{r}
performance_results <- read_tsv(here("output/results/Tonsils_10xFlex/Engineered/DoubletCallingPerformance/Tonsils_10xFlex_engineered_12k_0.15p_AllBatches_correctAssignments_MCC.csv"), show_col_types = F, col_types = c("ccnnnnnnnnnnnn"))
```



## plotting shortcuts

```{r}
plot_sizing <- theme_bw() +theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 16, colour = "black"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 22),
         plot.subtitle= element_text(size = 18),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_blank())


plot_sizing_keep_legend <- theme_bw() +theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 16, colour = "black"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 22),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(size=16)) 

rotate_x <- theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))

strip_fix <- theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), 
                   strip.text = element_text(size = 14))

title_size <- theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "italic"))

```

## Colours 

```{r}
# method colours
ambient_tools_colours <- c( "#67BF5C", "#AD8BC9", 
                     "#A8786E", "#CDCC5D", "#6DCCDA")

names(ambient_tools_colours) <- c("uncorrected", "decontX", "decontX_BG",
                                            "soupX", "CellBender")

ambient_tool_levels <- c("uncorrected", "CellBender", "soupX", "decontX", "decontX_BG")

# doublet/singlet colours
doublet_colours <- c("#2E91E5", "#EB663B"); names(doublet_colours) <- c("singlet", "doublet")

```

## Directory names

```{r}
save_dir <- here("output/figures/v4")
```


## Initiate list

Initate list used to store plots for the figures. 

```{r}
main_figure <- list()

```



# Proportion of correctly assigned classes

## Scatterplot overviews

Scatterplot overview for all batches with summary mean+-1sd.


```{r}
data_summary <- performance_results %>%
  mutate(ambient_tool = factor(ambient_tool, levels = ambient_tool_levels)) %>%
  group_by(ambient_tool) %>%
  summarise(., singlet_mean = mean(singlet_Sensitivity),
            singlet_min = singlet_mean - sd(singlet_Sensitivity), 
              singlet_max = singlet_mean + sd(singlet_Sensitivity),
            doublet_mean = mean(doublet_Sensitivity), 
            doublet_min = doublet_mean - sd(doublet_Sensitivity), 
              doublet_max = doublet_mean + sd(doublet_Sensitivity))


p_main <- performance_results %>%
  mutate(ambient_tool = factor(ambient_tool, levels = ambient_tool_levels)) %>%
  ggplot(.) +
  geom_point(aes(x = doublet_Sensitivity, y = singlet_Sensitivity, colour=ambient_tool), size = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(data=data_summary,
    aes(y =singlet_mean, 
        x = doublet_mean,
        ymin = singlet_min,
        ymax = singlet_max, 
        colour = ambient_tool),
    width = 0
  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(data=data_summary,
    aes(x = doublet_mean, 
        y =singlet_mean,
        xmin = doublet_min,
        xmax = doublet_max, 
        colour = ambient_tool),
    height = 0
  ) +
    geom_point(data = data_summary, aes(x = doublet_mean, y =singlet_mean, colour = ambient_tool), size=5) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = data_summary, aes(x = doublet_mean, y =singlet_mean, colour = ambient_tool, label = ambient_tool), size=6, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ambient_tools_colours)+
  plot_sizing + 
  ylab("proportion true singlets") + xlab("proportion true doublets\n(doublet sensitivity)")+
  ylim(c(0,1.05)) + xlim(c(0,1)) + ggtitle("Correct droplet assignments") +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin =0.33, xmax = 0.9,
                ymin = 0.9, ymax = 1.05),
            fill = NA, colour = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) + theme(legend.position = "none")


p_zoom <- performance_results %>%
  mutate(ambient_tool = factor(ambient_tool, levels = ambient_tool_levels)) %>%
  ggplot(.) +
  geom_point(aes(x = doublet_Sensitivity, y = singlet_Sensitivity, colour=ambient_tool), size = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(data=data_summary,
    aes(y =singlet_mean, 
        x = doublet_mean,
        ymin = singlet_min,
        ymax = singlet_max, 
        colour = ambient_tool),
    width = 0
  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(data=data_summary,
    aes(x = doublet_mean, 
        y =singlet_mean,
        xmin = doublet_min,
        xmax = doublet_max, 
        colour = ambient_tool),
    height = 0
  ) +
    geom_point(data = data_summary, aes(x = doublet_mean, y =singlet_mean, colour = ambient_tool), size=4) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = data_summary, aes(x = doublet_mean, y =singlet_mean, colour = ambient_tool, label = ambient_tool), size=6, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ambient_tools_colours)+
  plot_sizing + theme(legend.position = "none")+
  ylab("proportion true singlets") + xlab("proportion true doublets\n(doublet sensitivity)")+
  xlim(c(0.33,0.9)) + ylim(c(0.955,0.99)) + ggtitle("highlighted area")

```


```{r, fig.align='center', fig.height=8, fig.width=12}

layout <- c("AAABB
             AAAXX")

main_figure$performance_props <-(p_main + p_zoom + plot_layout(design =layout) &title_size)
main_figure$performance_props

```



### Barplot, remaining doublets

Show remaining doublets

```{r, fig.align='center', fig.height=5, fig.width=6}

data_summary <- performance_results %>%
  mutate(., prop_missed_doublets = 1-doublet_Sensitivity) %>% 
  mutate(ambient_tool = factor(ambient_tool, levels = ambient_tool_levels)) %>%
  group_by(ambient_tool) %>%
  summarise(., mean_missing = mean(prop_missed_doublets),
            missing_min = mean_missing - sd(prop_missed_doublets), 
              missing_max = mean_missing + sd(prop_missed_doublets), 
            mean_count = median(missed_doublet_n))


main_figure$undetected_doublets <- data_summary %>% 
  ggplot(.) +
  geom_bar(aes(x=ambient_tool, y = mean_missing, fill=ambient_tool),stat="identity")+
  geom_errorbar(data=data_summary, aes(x=ambient_tool, ymin=missing_min, ymax=missing_max), width=0.2) +
  plot_sizing + rotate_x + xlab("") + ylab("proportion of\nall doublets")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = ambient_tools_colours) +
  geom_text(aes(x=ambient_tool, y = mean_missing, label=paste0("n=", mean_count)), vjust=2.2, size=5) +
  geom_text(aes(x=ambient_tool, y = mean_missing, label=paste0("(", round(mean_missing,2), ")")), vjust=4.2, size=5) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  ggtitle("Undetected doublets") +title_size

main_figure$undetected_doublets
```



# MCC

## Barplot MCC

```{r, fig.align='center', fig.height=5, fig.width=6}

data_summary <- performance_results %>%
  mutate(ambient_tool = factor(ambient_tool, levels = ambient_tool_levels)) %>%
  group_by(ambient_tool) %>%
  summarise(., mean_MCC = mean(mcc),
            MCC_min = mean_MCC - sd(mcc), 
              MCC_max = mean_MCC + sd(mcc))


main_figure$mcc <- data_summary %>% 
  ggplot(.) +
  geom_bar(aes(x=ambient_tool, y = mean_MCC, fill=ambient_tool),stat="identity")+
  geom_errorbar(data=data_summary, aes(x=ambient_tool, ymin=MCC_min, ymax=MCC_max), width=0.2) +
  plot_sizing + rotate_x + xlab("") + ylab("MCC")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = ambient_tools_colours) +
  geom_text(aes(x=ambient_tool, y = mean_MCC, label=paste0("(", round(mean_MCC,3), ")")), vjust=2, size=5) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  ggtitle("MCC") + title_size

main_figure$mcc

```

# Main Figure

Read in workflow image from drawio.

```{r}
my_image <- readPNG(here("output/figures/workflow_figure_04.png"))
image_workflow <- rasterGrob(my_image)
```



```{r, fig.align='center', fig.height=12, fig.width=18}
design_layout <- c("AABBBB
                    AABBBB
                    AABBBB
                    CCDDXX
                    CCDDXX")

patch <- wrap_elements(image_workflow) +
  wrap_elements(main_figure$performance_props) +
  wrap_elements(main_figure$mcc) +
  wrap_elements(main_figure$undetected_doublets) +
  plot_layout(design = design_layout) + 
  plot_annotation(tag_levels ="A") & 
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 20,face = "bold"))

ggsave(plot = patch,
       filename = "Figure_03_EngineeredDataset_DoubletEvaluation.png",
       path = save_dir,
       device = "png",
       width = 18,
       height =12,
       dpi = 1200,
       bg = "transparent")

patch

```
